title: Trump's proposed arch is so big the FAA is reviewing it
text:
The FAA is set to evaluate the risks of building the president’s “triumphal arch” less than two miles from Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport.

CNN's Manu Raju pressed House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries about the Democrats' redistricting loss in Virginia. In a 4-3 ruling, state Supreme Court justices nullified a new congressional map that would have given Democrats the chance to win up to four additional seats in the House of Representatives. Vice President JD Vance wouldn't weigh in on 2028 when asked Wednesday about the potential for running on a presidential ticket with Secretary of State Marco Rubio.
The question came days after Trump polled a Rose Garden audience about which man should lead the ticket in 2028. President Donald Trump was welcomed in China’s capital with pomp and pageantry for the start of a crucial visit carrying global consequences, as the world’s two largest economies frame their trade relationship. CNN's Kristen Holmes reports from Beijing.
President Donald Trump had hoped to focus on US economic priorities with Chinese President Xi Jinping, but the Iran war — and his failed efforts at a peace deal — will complicate the US president’s prior goals. CNN's Betsy Klein reports from Beijing. The day before US President Donald Trump departed for Beijing, Washington blacklisted a dozen people and entities they say are linked to the trade of oil from Iran to China.
CNN's Simone McCarthy traveled to one facility in China's Hebei province, sanctioned last year for allegedly funding Tehran by quietly processing Iranian crude to fuel the world’s second largest economy. The assassination of Francisco Beltran, an alleged cartel operative, on a Mexican highway in March was facilitated by American CIA officers. According to multiple sources, it was part of an expanded and previously unreported CIA operation inside the country.
The CIA declined to comment when first informed of CNN's reporting, but then called it a"PR stunt" for the cartel after it published. CNN’s Natasha Bertrand reports. CNN's Kaitlan Collins speaks with former FBI Director James Comey about being indicted for a second time by the Department of Justice. New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani has ditched a nearly 10% property tax hike in his budget proposal, a “last resort plan” to balance the city’s budget gap.
The New York City Council will vote on the budget by the end of June. CNN’s Katherine Koretski breaks down Mamdani’s tax measurements. President Trump was asked on Tuesday to what extent Americans’ financial situation was motivating him to make a deal with Iran.
